name: payments-001-baseline
statements: CREATE TABLE invoice_payments(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,invoice_id TEXT NOT NULL,organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,amount TEXT NOT NULL,currency TEXT NOT NULL,payment_date TEXT NOT NULL,method TEXT NOT NULL,external_reference TEXT,note TEXT,actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'payment' CONSTRAINT invoice_payments_kind_valid CHECK(kind IN('payment','reversal')),reverses_payment_id TEXT REFERENCES invoice_payments(id),UNIQUE(organization_id,id),FOREIGN KEY(invoice_id)REFERENCES issued_invoices(id))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX invoice_payments_reversal ON invoice_payments(reverses_payment_id) WHERE reverses_payment_id IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE payment_idempotency_records(organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT payment_idempotency_records_key_length CHECK(length(idempotency_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 255),operation TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT payment_idempotency_records_operation_valid CHECK(operation IN('record_payment','reverse_payment')),fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT payment_idempotency_records_fingerprint_shape CHECK(length(fingerprint)=71 AND substr(fingerprint,1,7)='sha256:' AND substr(fingerprint,8) !~ '[^0-9a-f]'),result_id TEXT NOT NULL,created_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(organization_id,idempotency_key),FOREIGN KEY(result_id)REFERENCES invoice_payments(id))

CREATE TRIGGER invoice_payments_reversal_shape BEFORE INSERT ON invoice_payments FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((NEW.kind='reversal')!=(NEW.reverses_payment_id IS NOT NULL)) EXECUTE FUNCTION qwbe_abort('a reversal references exactly one payment')
CREATE TRIGGER invoice_payments_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON invoice_payments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION qwbe_abort('payments are immutable')
CREATE TRIGGER invoice_payments_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON invoice_payments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION qwbe_abort('payments are immutable')
CREATE TRIGGER payment_idempotency_records_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON payment_idempotency_records FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION qwbe_abort('payment idempotency record is immutable')
CREATE TRIGGER payment_idempotency_records_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON payment_idempotency_records FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION qwbe_abort('payment idempotency record is immutable')
